name: Keen Salve
description: Rub a sharp cool salve of soul force into a fresh soul wound so the bleeding of spirit stops in the ally.

name: Kernel Reading
description: Press two fingers to a patient's chest and feel the core of the soul to learn how firmly it holds.

name: Hush Weave
description: Weave a hush of soul force over a healing patient so the noise of battle cannot unsettle the soul.

name: Calm Draught
description: Pour a calm draught of soul force into an ally and let it steady the ally's wavering will.

name: Mender's Rinse
description: Rinse the lingering stain of a soul-borne curse from an ally with long strokes of clean force.

name: Lumen Sinew
description: Lay new bands of light along a torn soul like sinew so the ally's soul can bear weight again.

name: Soul Restoration
description: Rebuild a gravely wounded ally's soul from the core outward with long deliberate pours of the healer's force.

name: Lifepulse Recall
description: Call back the soul of an ally whose breath stopped only moments ago and press it into the body before the window closes.

name: Crack Divining
description: Trace the outline of a patient's soul with a feeler of force to find where it has cracked.

name: Edge Dressing
description: Lay a clean dressing of soul force over the ragged edge of a broken soul to keep the ally steady.

name: Padded Hold
description: Pad a cracked soul with thick layers of force so the ally can be carried without the pieces grinding.

name: Grip Warmth
description: Clasp an ally's hands and pass warmth of soul force through them until the ally's will firms.

name: Fracture Setting
description: Align the two halves of a cracked soul with steady hands of force and hold them true while they fuse.

name: Cinder Cleansing
description: Lift the burnt cinders of a scorching soul strike from an ally's wound without reopening it.

name: Borrowed Vigor
description: Lend a measure of the healer's own soul strength to a failing ally who must keep standing.

name: Shattered Reassembly
description: Gather the scattered pieces of a shattered soul and fit them back into one whole in an ally.

name: Final Tether
description: Catch the thread of a dying ally's soul in the last heartbeat and tie it fast to the body.

name: Surface Wash
description: Wash the surface of an ally's soul with clear force to lift the first film of grime.

name: Murk Sense
description: Skim a patient's soul for the dark murk of a curse or taint and mark how thick it lies.

name: Pure Veil
description: Hang a pure white veil of force over a cleansed ally so no taint settles on the soul again.

name: Clear Intent
description: Clear the fog from an ally's thinking with a cool breath of soul force until the ally's aim is sure.

name: Mote Drift
description: Coax the last small motes of foreign force to drift out of an ally's soul on a slow tide.

name: Murk Draining
description: Drain the thick murk of a curse from an ally's soul through the healer's open palms.

name: Erosion Stay
description: Halt the slow wearing away of an ally's soul by wrapping the thinned places in fresh force.

name: Backlash Easing
description: Ease the scalding backlash of a failed breakthrough from an ally's soul and meridians with slow cool pulses.

name: Erosion Purge
description: Burn out every trace of soul erosion from an ally in one great purge of clean force.

name: Curse Unwinding
description: Follow the knotted threads of a curse through an ally's soul and unwind them one at a time.

name: Dyad Salve
description: Spread a salve of soul force with both palms at once so a bruised soul eases from two sides.

name: Doubled Pulse
description: Send two pulses of soul force through a patient and compare their echoes to find a hidden wound.

name: Counterpart Ward
description: Raise a second ward as the mirror of the first so a patient is guarded from both sides.

name: Matched Warmth
description: Match the warmth of one hand to the other and press both on an ally until the ally's soul rouses.

name: Dual Mend
description: Knit a wounded soul from both edges at once so the two seams meet in the middle of the ally.

name: Pair Rinse
description: Wash an ally's soul with two opposing streams of clean force that carry the stain away between them.

name: Twin Restoration
description: Restore a badly harmed ally's soul with two interlocked flows of force that each mend what the other cannot reach.

name: Paired Recall
description: Call a newly stopped ally back with two hands of force that draw the soul and push the heart in turn.

name: Down Feather
description: Brush a light feather of soul force across a sore soul so the hurt of the ally lifts away.

name: Kestrel Sight
description: Look down on a patient's soul from above with keen sight and pick out the one place that is hurt.

name: Quillfeather Cover
description: Spread both arms like wings over a fallen ally and fold a shell of soul force around the ally.

name: Warmcurrent Lift
description: Send a rising current of soul force beneath an ally and buoy the ally's flagging spirit upward.

name: Swoop Mending
description: Dive soul force straight onto the one worst wound of an ally and close it in a single pass.

name: Talon Loosing
description: Pry loose a binding that grips an ally's soul by working the healer's force under it like a talon.

name: Cerulean Surge
description: Wash an ally in a clear blue surge of soul force that restores focus and the will to go on.

name: Cobalt Renewal
description: Bathe a gravely hurt ally in wide clean soul force until the whole soul glows whole and bright again.

name: Skyward Recall
description: Lift a newly fallen ally's soul back toward the body on a bright upward stroke before it escapes.

name: Filled Palm
description: Let healing force gather in a hollow of the healer's palm and then pour it into an ally's wound.

name: Flow Read
description: Follow the flow of a patient's soul current upstream until the blockage that dams it appears.

name: Steadying Ward
description: Raise firm banks of soul force along an ally's current so a surge cannot overflow and tear it.

name: Ripple Cheer
description: Send a bright ripple of soul force outward from the healer that lifts every tired ally it touches.

name: Silt Lifting
description: Stir and lift the silt that clogs a soul current so the ally's force runs freely again.

name: Streamwise Mend
description: Patch the breaks in an ally's soul current with force that flows along it and seals as it goes.

name: Silt Draining
description: Draw a slow drain through a fouled soul current and let the heavy silt of poison settle out.

name: Tributary Flow
description: Feed the healer's own streams into an ally's thin current until it runs strong enough to carry the ally on.

name: Confluence Mend
description: Draw every stream of an ally's broken soul together into one channel and seal the whole in a single great mend.

name: Homeward Tide
description: Send a full tide of soul force back through a newly stopped ally to carry the soul home before it ebbs.

name: Zephyr Unguent
description: Fan a cool breeze of soul force over a hot bruised soul until the sting leaves the ally.

name: Draft Sense
description: Feel the draft that leaks from a wounded soul to find the tear that causes it.

name: Lee Cover
description: Turn the healer's body into a lee of soul force that breaks the blast of battle before it reaches a patient.

name: Fresh Gust
description: Blow a fresh gust of soul force through an ally's thoughts and sweep away the weariness.

name: Oathsealed Mend
description: Speak the healer's oath aloud while soul force binds an ally's wound as steadily as the words.

name: Gust Rinse
description: Let a clean wind of soul force blow through an ally's soul and carry off the stain.

name: Bearing Restoration
description: Hold a true bearing on the shape of an ally's whole soul and rebuild it to that shape with patient force.

name: Vowed Recall
description: Call back a newly stopped ally by the healer's oath with a pull of soul force no distance can slacken.

name: Aloft Palm
description: Hold an open palm over a wounded soul and let healing force drop into it like rain.

name: Wind Listening
description: Listen to the sigh of a patient's soul as to a far wind and learn which wound pains the most.

name: Free Veil
description: Throw a light veil of soul force over a patient that moves with the wind and turns the strike aside.

name: Keel Steadying
description: Give an ally a fixed point to steer by with calm soul force that holds the ally's course.

name: Sky Mending
description: Draw wide clear force down from above like open sky and lay it over an ally's soul wound.

name: Mist Lifting
description: Lift the clinging mist of a confusion-curse from an ally's soul with slow warm sweeps.

name: Oath Strength
description: Pour the force of a spoken oath into a wavering ally until the ally's resolve is iron.

name: Tireless Mend
description: Mend an ally's soul hour after hour without slackening as the healer draws force from the open air.

name: Windborne Recall
description: Catch a newly fallen ally's soul on a rising wind of force and carry it home to the body.

name: Reed Bandage
description: Bind a wounded soul with long supple strips of force that give and do not tear.

name: Vortex Sense
description: Trace the small eddies in a patient's soul force back to the wound that is spinning them.

name: Steady Mantle
description: Hold a steady shelter of soul force over a patient for as long as the long night lasts.

name: Lifting Draft
description: Share a cool draft of soul force with a worn ally that renews the ally without draining the healer.

name: Whistle Calm
description: Whistle a low unbroken tone that settles a frightened ally's soul while force knits it.

name: Pledge Mending
description: Bind a soul wound with force that holds as firm as a vow the healer has sworn to the ally.

name: Yoke Lifting
description: Lift the heavy burden of a binding curse from an ally's soul a fraction at a time.

name: Pledged Vigor
description: Share the energy of a vow with an ally who is spent so the ally can stand another hour.

name: Unflagging Restoration
description: Pour the whole of the healer's stamina into one long restoration that renews an ally's ruined soul.

name: Oathbound Rescue
description: Bind a newly stopped ally's soul to the healer's oath and drag it back into the waiting body.
